help.w: A calendar flag for the last 2 + first 3 trading days of a month (and especially a quarter-end: Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec). Big funds rebalance on these days — 'window dressing' is buying the quarter's winners to show them on reports; pension/index rebalancing fires market-on-close orders that move breadth.
help.r: 📅 means you're in a window. Quarter-end is the stronger version. On flagged days the tape's internals (TICK/TRIN/ADD/ADSPD) are downgraded and sizing is halved.
help.u: Trust the internals less near the turn — a breadth surge on Jun 30 may be pension rebalancing, not real buying — and size down. For the 401(k) tilt, prefer executing early in a quarter rather than into quarter-end distortion.
help.c: ⚠ Real but small and decayed effect — this sizes you DOWN and distrusts the tape near the turn; it is NOT a setup and never generates a trade. Trigger is still price.
